title: Element count of str.splitlines() on a mainframe record
prompt:
We ingest records exported from an old mainframe system and break each record into fields with `record.splitlines()`. For one record, written here as a Python string literal with escape sequences,

    record = 'id=7\x1cname=Ada\u2028role=eng\r\nteam=core\x85'

a colleague expects exactly two fields, because the only "real" line break in it is the `\r\n`. How many elements does `record.splitlines()` actually return in CPython 3 (3.8 or newer)?

Answer with a single integer.
